48  const commands = useCommands(query);
  49  return commands.map(cmd => <Item onSelect={cmd.run} />);

children.name: Code excerpt
children.characters:
31  const matches = fuzzySearch(registry, query.trim());
  32  return matches.filter(cmd => cmd.isAvailable(repo));
